note.ja: 有限格子の数値参照 x′=v,v′=μ(1−x²)v−x、初期値(2,0)、T=2。2方式×3刻み×2μと適応4runで計16run。 測定後の報告範囲変更で、数値的な修復ではありません。初回誤差4.535633779e-5は元目標2e-5を超えます。局所rtolは大域誤差を保証せず、報告検証の合格は全元目標の達成ではありません。大μ全周期は対象外です。
note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference The system is xprime = v and vprime = mu(1 - x squared)v - x, initially (2, 0), over T = 2. Two fixed methods, three step counts and two mu values plus four adaptive runs give 16 runs. This post-measurement reporting revision is not a numerical repair. The first error, 4.535633779e-5, exceeded the original 2e-5 goal. Local tolerances do not guarantee global accuracy, and reporting PASS does not mean all original goals were met. Full large-mu cycles are outside scope.

note.en: Semi-analytic reference Solve u_t = u_xx + u on [0, 1] with both boundary values equal to 1, an analytic steady state plus a 0.1 sine perturbation, and T = 0.1. Use 31, 63 and 127 interior nodes with 8, 16, 32 and 64 steps, plus four Lie controls: 28 runs. This is an authored linear specialization, not a reproduction of the original nonlinear tables. It makes no general claim for nonautonomous boundaries or universal order loss. The final reaction-trace mismatch of Lie splitting is disclosed separately.

note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference A nondimensional three-species system starts at (1, 0, 0) and ends at T = 0.4. Accuracy is sampled on T <= 0.4; this does not validate long-time chemistry or an all-time error bound.

note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference Model time zero to four; the intermediate-species state and residual scale is 1e-4. Printing intervals and numerical errors are distinct. Only two official SUNDIALS v7.1.1 printed rows; zero new IDA executions, with no long-time chemistry or general DAE-performance claim. No asymptotic-convergence or all-original-accuracy-goals claim is made for this fixed schedule.
